svg.title: Playing with Fire: the trail map
svg.desc: The talk as a pixel game map at night: a dotted trail leads past nine stations, 00 Gather, 01 Who, 02 Spark, 03 Kindling, 04 Feed, then over a bridge across the river to 05 Forge, 06 Smoke, 07 Embers and 08 Open fire, and ends at a crackling campfire. Hills, forests and snowy mountains around. A blinking marker says: you are here, at station 00.
